t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The aim is to keep track of which of the forests (bright or dark) yield the most mushrooms. To do so it is important to keep an eye on which gnomes will take me to that forest once I've identified that that forest has the highest yield.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will always be in pairs - orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow, or blue & purple. Their positions will change round to round but always be in the pairs above.The orange, green, red, and blue will all lead to the same forest, the other colours in the pairings (brown, pink, yellow, and purple) will lead to the other forest - memorise these two groups in this paragraph and start by using one group - if doesn't seem to be gaining many mushrooms then try the other group - stick with the group that's bringing in more mushrooms - if you get a zero switch to the other group and see if that is more successful as it seems to change now and again. Good luck!
